info.title: Google Drive MCP REST API
info.description: REST API for managing Google Drive files and folders. For use with ChatGPT Custom Actions.

post.summary: Create a Google Doc, optionally with initial text
post.description: Shipped on the owner request for full REST coverage of non-destructive writes. Not idempotent: each call creates another document. Works with shared drives. Answers 201 even when the text insert failed, because the document exists by then: initialContentWritten is false with initialContentError, and null when no text was sent. Body limit 5mb.

parentFolderId.description: ID of folder where document should be created. If not provided, creates in Drive root. For shared drives, use a folder ID within the shared drive.

initialContent.description: Initial text content to add to the document.

get.description: Gets metadata for a specific file in Google Drive.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The file ID

delete.description: Deletes a file from Google Drive. By default moves to trash unless permanent is true.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The file ID to delete

parameters.name: permanent
parameters.description: Whether to permanently delete the file instead of moving to trash

post.description: Creates a copy of a file in Google Drive.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The file ID to copy

newName.description: Name for the copied file. Defaults to 'Copy of <original name>'.

parentFolderId.description: Folder ID to place the copy in. Defaults to the same folder as the original.

get.description: Lists files and subfolders within a specified folder.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: The folder ID (use 'root' for the root folder)

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: nextPageToken from the previous page.

post.description: Creates a new folder in Google Drive.

parentFolderId.description: Parent folder ID. Defaults to the root folder.

get.summary: Search all of Drive by name or content, or list recent files
get.description: Any file type and folder. Omit q for the most recently modified files. Paginated with nextPageToken; incompleteSearch true means Drive skipped some locations. A fullText search is ordered by relevance.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text to look for. Omit to list the most recently modified files.

parameters.name: searchIn
parameters.description: Match the query against file names, file content, or both.

parameters.name: mimeType
parameters.description: Optional type filter: document, spreadsheet, presentation, folder, form, pdf, or any MIME type (e.g. "image/png").

parameters.name: modifiedAfter
parameters.description: Only files modified after this RFC 3339 time, e.g. "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z".

parameters.name: includeTrashed
parameters.description: Include files in the trash.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Files per page (1-100).

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: nextPageToken from a previous call, to get the next page.

parameters.name: includeSharedDrives
parameters.description: Include items from shared drives. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: driveId
parameters.description: Filter to a specific shared drive ID.

parameters.name: corpora
parameters.description: Source of files: user (My Drive), drive (specific), allDrives, domain.

post.summary: Upload a file, optionally converting it to a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides
post.description: Body limit 5mb (about 3.7 MB of file as base64). Not idempotent. convertTo is checked against what Drive can import from sourceMimeType.

fileName.description: Name for the file in Drive, e.g. "budget.xlsx".

sourceMimeType.description: MIME type of the content, e.g. "text/csv", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", "application/pdf".

contentBase64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded. Give this or textContent.

textContent.description: The file as UTF-8 text (CSV, Markdown, HTML, plain text). Give this or contentBase64.

parentFolderId.description: Folder (or shared drive) to put it in. Defaults to My Drive root.

convertTo.description: Convert into a native Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file. Checked against what Drive can import from sourceMimeType.

converted.description: true only when Drive stored it as the requested Google type.

400.description: Invalid body, both or neither content field, over 20 MB, or a conversion Drive cannot do

get.description: Without pageToken returns startPageToken and no changes. nextPageToken means more changes now; newStartPageToken means the end of the feed, poll later with it.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Token from a previous call (newStartPageToken or nextPageToken). Omit on the first call to get a starting token: changes are recorded from that moment on.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Changes per page (1-1000).

parameters.name: driveId
parameters.description: Optional shared drive ID, to follow that drive instead of My Drive.

post.summary: Move a file or folder to another folder
post.description: Moves a file or folder to a different location in Google Drive (works with shared drives). Send removeFromAllParents true to move it. It defaults to false, which leaves the original where it is and puts a copy in the destination (Drive allows one parent per item, and folders cannot be copied).

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The Drive file or folder ID

newParentId.description: ID of the destination folder. Use "root" for Drive root. For shared drives, use a folder ID within the shared drive.

removeFromAllParents.description: If true, moves the item: removes it from all current parents. If false, leaves the original where it is and puts a copy in the destination.

201.description: Copied into the destination (action is copied); the original is unchanged

400.description: Bad request - the body failed validation (issues lists the fields)

404.description: File or destination folder not found

post.description: Renames a file or folder in Google Drive (works with shared drives).

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The Drive file or folder ID

newName.description: New name for the file or folder.

200.description: Renamed; the file with its new name

400.description: Bad request - the body failed validation (issues lists the fields)

post.summary: Move a file or folder to the trash
post.description: Moves a file or folder (with its contents) to the Drive trash, where it can be restored. This endpoint never deletes permanently: skipTrash true is refused with 400. Destructive, exposed with explicit sign-off: the permanent dashboard API key can call it.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The Drive file or folder ID

skipTrash.description: Not accepted as true here: this endpoint only moves to the trash.

200.description: In the trash, as Drive reports it

400.description: Bad request - the body failed validation (issues lists the fields)

502.description: Drive accepted the request but did not report the file as trashed

get.description: Lists who has access to a Google Drive file or folder, and with what role.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The Drive file or folder ID

post.summary: Share a file or folder by granting a permission
post.description: Shares a Google Drive file or folder by creating a permission. Required fields by type: user or group need emailAddress; domain needs domain; anyone (a public link) needs neither. Emails user and group grantees unless sendNotification is false. Exposed with explicit sign-off: the permanent dashboard API key can call it.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The Drive file or folder ID

emailAddress.description: Email address of the user or group.

sendNotification.description: Whether to send an email notification (only for user/group shares).

expirationTime.description: Expiration time in RFC 3339 format. Only for user/group shares on files (not folders).

permission.description: The permission Drive created (id, type, role)

400.description: Bad request - the body failed validation (issues lists the fields)

post.summary: Create a Google Doc from a template
post.description: Copies a Google Docs template and replaces placeholder text in the copy (matching ignores case). Answers 201 with the new document even when the replacements fail; replacements says what happened to them.

parameters.name: templateId
parameters.description: ID of the template document to copy from

parentFolderId.description: ID of folder where document should be created. If not provided, creates in Drive root. For shared drives, use a folder ID within the shared drive.

replacements.description: Placeholder text to replace, e.g. {"{{NAME}}": "John Doe"}.
null when none were sent. applied true with occurrencesChanged per placeholder (0 means not found), or applied false with the error.

400.description: Bad request - the body failed validation, or the template is not a Google Doc (checked before anything is copied)

404.description: Template or parent folder not found

bearerAuth.description: API key obtained from the registration dashboard

size.description: Size of the file in bytes

modifiedTime.description: When the file was last modified

webViewLink.description: Link to open the file in a browser
